_doc: Ship hub: rooms, exits and console destinations. Rooms form a GRAPH and every one must be reachable from the bridge; travel is a mode (drive/fly/land) rather than a loading screen, since the engine already has landing and flight.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.blurb: Navigation console. Choose where the ship goes next.

corridor_fore.name: Forward Corridor
corridor_fore.blurb: Spine of the ship. Viewports on both sides.

upgrade_bay.name: Upgrade Bay
upgrade_bay.blurb: Chassis rigs and part racks. Rebuild your bot here.

market.name: Trade Deck
market.blurb: Whoever docked last is still selling.

quarters.name: Crew Quarters
quarters.blurb: Where the crew bring you problems.

corridor_aft.name: Aft Corridor
corridor_aft.blurb: Colder back here. The hull ticks as it cools.

airlock.name: Airlock
airlock.blurb: Cycle through and walk the hull. No gravity past this door.

hangar.name: Hangar
hangar.blurb: Drop bay. Launches and landings come through here.

pluto_line.name: The Pluto Line
pluto_line.blurb: Outer containment. Long fall, hard landing.

rust_flats.name: Rust Flats
rust_flats.blurb: Open ground. Drive it if you want the scenery.

frost_shelf.name: Frost Shelf
frost_shelf.blurb: Ice shelves calve under weight. Land light.

ember_descent.name: Ember Descent
ember_descent.blurb: Thermals from the lava pools. Fly it in.

the_maw.name: The Maw
the_maw.blurb: Horizon curves the wrong way. Something is awake.

kuiper_drift.name: Kuiper Drift
kuiper_drift.blurb: Shepherd moons and a frozen debris braid.

foundry_run.name: Foundry Run
foundry_run.blurb: Smelt channels still running. Mind the heat.

the_trench.name: The Trench
the_trench.blurb: Rift dark. Your lights are the only ones.

shield_edge.name: Shield Edge
shield_edge.blurb: The boundary is failing. Watch it flicker.

mars_frame.name: Mars Frame
mars_frame.blurb: A piece of Cybertron fell here. It is still warm.
